chapter: Favorite bands, advice and family reflections
title: What he would record now
summary: He agrees to record six songs with piano and guitar after practicing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: If someone came to you and said, Higgy, I want you to make a record for me.
It would be a pleasure in a couple of weeks.
What would you want to record? What songs would you want to record? Say, you could record six songs, what six songs would you say/would you like to record?
Well, I have to think about it first. ... practicing. You just can't take up the horn today and say I'll play tomorrow. No, I'd have to do a whole lot of practicing.
Well, do you have any idea of any of the songs that you would record? Would it be 'Dear Old Southland' or 'Confessing'?
Yeah. Or as many as you feel.
What do you want, just trombone?
Piano and guitar. Trombone and guitar
Yeah, that's OK. You can do the furnishing,
So it doesn't make any difference whether it's one or a hundred.
